inert_because: Every one of the 13 aliases is read exactly once, always as `if <alias>.environ.get(ENV):`. The gate harness sets none of R7_DEBUG_IFGEN / R30_13_DEBUG / R23N6_DEBUG / R23N6_DEBUG2..5 / R23N6_TRACE, so all 13 gates evaluate false and no gated body ever executes. There is NO file I/O at any of the 13 sites (no .open / path.join / .write).
merge_note: 13 independent single-purpose anchors, one per debug site; sites L47347-L47371 are four adjacent non-overlapping anchors (else/else/elif/else) that must be applied in listed order.
